decision_source: User 2026-09-24: the executor's reverse-proxy API must be the GitHub project claude-code-openai-wrapper, used exactly like calling an HTTP model API (AGENTS §0.2.14-15).

wrapper.claude_agent_sdk: 0.2.159 (bundled Claude Code CLI 2.1.281, same version as the host CLI)
install_deviations_from_poetry_lock: mcp pin 1.27.2 dropped: lockfile inconsistent with the sdk pin; resolver chose mcp 1.30.0
uvloop dropped: Linux-only, cannot build on Windows
wrapper.launcher: research/benchmark/start_executor_wrapper.py (verifies commit, patch bytes and sdk version; loopback only; strips CLAUDE*/ANTHROPIC* env)

upstream_behaviour_found_by_code_review_.evidence: wrapper passes system_prompt {type:'text'}; SDK 0.2.159 only emits --system-prompt for str/custom/file/preset, so no flag is sent and the CLI uses its default Claude Code system prompt. Offline _build_command and live call 328: asked 'What is your name?' under system 'Your name is Quillon', upstream answered as a Claude Code agent that can run commands in the workspace.
no --setting-sources flag, so user/project settings, hooks and skills load; tools only denylisted by an outdated list (PowerShell, Agent, ToolSearch etc. not covered).

filter_content removes <thinking>, <args>, <bash>... blocks, replaces data:image base64 text, collapses blank lines, substitutes a canned sentence for empty replies. Live call 329: the model saw a prompt with the tags removed and reported 0 '<' characters; its <args>ok</args> answer was stripped to an empty code block.
prompt/completion tokens = len(text)//4 (call 329 reported 75 prompt tokens).
parameter not implemented; replies are plain text.
verify_cli sends 'Hello' with the Claude Code preset at every server start (ledger 312, 327 recorded after the fact).

upstream_behaviour_found_by_code_review_.issue: Silent model substitution by the CLI
upstream_behaviour_found_by_code_review_.evidence: without CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK the CLI answers a refused request with another model (call 317: claude-opus-5-5 refused 'cyber', answered by claude-opus-4-8, subtype model_refusal_fallback).
CLI debug log call 317: '[AdvisorTool] Server-side tool enabled with claude-opus-5-5 as the advisor model'.

behaviour: exactly the client's system message (or none) via --system-prompt; never the Claude Code preset

CLI env: refusal fallback, model fallback, advisor tool, attachments, auto/org memory, CLAUDE.md, git instructions, bundled/policy skills, background tasks, non-essential traffic, telemetry all disabled
user content passed unchanged; data-URL images as real image blocks; no content filtering
response_format json_schema -> provider structured output (--json-schema); content = its JSON
real usage from the CLI result; refusals -> 200 with finish_reason content_filter; upstream 4xx -> same 4xx
any response involving a model other than the requested one -> 502 model_substituted; any declared/used tool other than the structured-output channel -> 502
unsupported parameters (temperature, tools, multi-turn history, remote image URLs, stream) -> OpenAI-style 400, never approximated

conformance_runs.client: official openai Python SDK 1.109.1, only base_url/api_key differ from a hosted API
conformance_runs.superseded_runs: conformance-faithful-d8b6c63e (calls 313-316) and the C2/C5 attempts of conformance-faithful-v2 (321, 324: safeguard refusals then reported as 502 before the ResultError fix) predate the no-fallback switches; its C1 answer was probably produced by the fallback model, so it is not evidence.

results.case: C2 prompt and reply passed through unmodified
C4 data-URL image reaches the model
C5 refusal surfaced as content_filter by the requested model, no substitution
executor transport end-to-end (OpenAICompatTransport, action schema + image)

upstream_comparison.C1: fail (system message ignored; answered as Claude Code agent)
upstream_comparison.C2: fail (prompt tags and image text filtered; response_format ignored; reply stripped; usage len/4)

transport_findings_rechecked_on_correct_.finding: an output_schema with a property named 'reasoning' is refused (reasoning_extraction)
provider structured output rejects property keys outside ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$ (API 400)

residual_differences_from_a_bare_api_cal: Subscription OAuth access goes through Claude Code: the CLI prepends its identity/attribution system blocks and sends the claude-code/oauth beta headers. Measured cost: about 400 extra input tokens per request (neutral request 424 prompt tokens for ~25 tokens of content). This cannot be removed without leaving the supported subscription path.
Sampling parameters (temperature/top_p/max_tokens) are not settable through the CLI; faithful mode rejects them instead of emulating them.
One user turn per request (no role-separated history); the benchmark executor sends [system, user] only, so this does not constrain current harness calls, but a harness that sends history gets a 400.

The CLI downscales images whose long side exceeds 2000 px before the API request (observed earlier on the same CLI; controller tiles already handle this for the judge; executor-side tiling is not yet implemented).
Opus 5.5 safeguards refuse some benign prompts (instruction-override phrasing, verbatim-copy requests, 'reasoning' schema fields); these are model-level and would also occur on the hosted API.
not_yet_done: no H0 integration run through the wrapper yet
wrapper restart and crash handling not exercised under a running stage
